packs.title: Packs Management
packs.description: Approve free-delivery packs and keep an eye on every merchant pack
packs.showing_oldest: Showing the oldest {shown} of {total} — decide these to see the rest.

detail.unsellable_review: Customers can't see this pack until every item is from this store, available, approved and has a whole-number quantity — approving it won't change that. See the items flagged above.
detail.unsellable_active: Customers can't see this pack until every item is from this store, available, approved and has a whole-number quantity. See the items flagged above.
detail.unsellable_empty: This pack has no items, so customers can't see it.
detail.free_delivery_hint: Approving lets this pack go live with free delivery. Blink covers the delivery fee.

decision.note_hint_review: Only sent if you reject — required then, and shown to the merchant. Approving ignores it.
decision.note_required: Add a note so the merchant knows why.
decision.reject_placeholder: e.g. The discount and free delivery together sell this pack below cost…
decision.deactivate_placeholder: e.g. This pack contains an item that is no longer allowed…

errors.network: Couldn't reach Blink Server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.forbidden: Your staff role isn't allowed to manage packs.
errors.not_found: This pack no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
errors.invalid: Blink Server refused this decision. Rejecting or deactivating needs a reason. ({detail})
errors.conflict: This pack changed or was already decided since you opened it (or it can't change from its current status). The list has been refreshed — reopen it to see the latest version.
errors.throttled: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

empty.review: No packs waiting for review. All caught up!
